job.label: Service pistol repaint — Relic
job.keep_line: the same single right-facing level side-view service pistol repaint, broad straight dark steel slide with its current angular front bevel, dark circular muzzle, three rear sloping serration cuts, rectangular upper-side port and small original top sights, stepped lower frame/dust cover, short rectangular trigger guard with its single curved trigger, and downward-sloping blue-grey inset grip panel secured by TWO round metal pins over the same dark grip base. Preserve every slide corner, port, sight, screw, trigger gap, under-frame step and grip angle; the magazine remains flush at the bottom. The original muted steel-blue grip inset stays at its current place. No accessory rail addition, optic, enlarged magazine, logo, lettering or external effect.
job.prompt:
Paint ONE Relic Service Pistol inventory icon for the fictional RPG Project Heaven Cry. Only a2D digital painting. First attachment is a technical reference pair: LEFT Standard fixes exact visible geometry/pose/framing; RIGHT Masterwork supplies prior surface additions. Render one complete pistol only, with no panel, label, extra object or scene. Second attachment supplies Heavenprint brushwork only, no person.

Relic appearance: same silhouette, THREE rear cuts, TWO grip pins, all dark openings, exact grip/guard and every part position. Keep the Masterwork upper-side inlay route, now painted dull old gold. Steel has warm deep oiled blued-brown patina, never rust; the original blue-grey grip is darker and glassy-smooth with age, preserving its blue identity. Existing brass fittings look old and cared for. ONE small flush rectangle of fine engraved scroll curves, no letters or figures, sits on the existing upper-side surface beside the inlay. ONE old repair: the existing LOWER grip pin appears contrasting plain steel instead of brass, exactly the same size in the same hole. No added pin, plate, fitting or damage. Keep every previous addition.

Opaque Heavenprint gouache/ink, directional broken brushstrokes, selective dry-brush, charcoal shadows, restrained warm ivory focal edges and upper-left light. Transparent1024x1024RGBA, same reference framing and at least50px clear margin. No cast shadow, ground, hand, figure, text, numbers, letters, logo, real brand, border, frame, smoke, flash or external glow. Exterior artwork only; no diagram or instructions.
